we propose a novel online object categorization framework that can collect images and learn object models simultaneously.
we present a novel online object recognition algorithm that is capable of automatic image collection and incremental model learning.
we propose a novel object recognition system that performs automatic online picture collection via incremental model learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two important problems in computer vision, object categorization and dataset collecting.

the following questions: How to collect a large dataset of object categories from the Internet in a semi-automatic way? How to learn robust object recognition models from the collected dataset? How to use the learned models to automatically collect more data and improve the model in an iterative way?
the automatic online collection of image datasets for object recognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
OPTIMOL can be used to automatically collect a much larger object category dataset than the manually collected ones.
the proposed OPTIMOL framework is a novel and powerful tool for automatic online picture collection and incremental object category model learning.
OPTIMOL can collect more relevant images and build more robust models for a wide range of object classes, compared to existing methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OPTIMOL can be seen as a new paradigm for automatic image collection and object recognition.
OPTIMOL can be used to automatically collect a large amount images, learn robust object recognition models and annotate images.

our algorithm can automatically collect large object category datasets from web images and incrementally learn a robust object model for each category, which can be used for image annotation and object recognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn a robust object model from a small number of examples and automatically collect much larger datasets.
the web is a rich resource for collecting large datasets and that automatic dataset gathering is feasible.

automatic online dataset collection can be a very effective tool for building a robust generic object recognition system, which is essential to many applications such as image retrieval, object detection, and scene understanding.
